title: Did the Models Understand Documents? Benchmarking Models for Language Understanding in Document-Level Relation Extraction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness using Entity Name Attacks, which include masking all entity names, randomly shuffling entity names within a document, and substituting entity names with out-of-distribution (OOD) entities to expose the model's reliance on entity memorization.

Visualizing and analyzing the mean attribution values (using the Integrated Gradients feature attribution method) of tokens across different positions in a document to demonstrate that models disproportionately weight tokens based on their fixed positions rather than semantic meaning.

Using feature attribution to identify reliance on non-causal tokens like high-frequency function words and punctuation, and executing word-level evidence attacks (masking human rationales, antonym substitution, synonym substitution) to show models fail to use proper reasoning paths.
